a̠jānha̠ vai pṛśnī̍gͫͫstapa̠syamā̍nā̠n brahma̍ svayaṃ̠bhva̍bhyāna̍rṣa̠tta ṛṣa̍yo'bhava̠n tadṛṣī̍ṇāmṛṣi̠tvaṃ tāṃ de̠vatā̠mupā̍tiṣṭhanta ya̠jñakā̍mā̠sta e̠taṃ bra̍hmaya̠jñama̍paśya̠ntamā'ha̍ra̠ntenā̍yajanta̠ yadṛ̠co'ddhyagī̍ṣata̠ tāḥ paya̍ āhutayo de̠vānā̍mabhava̠n̠yadyajū̍gͫṣi ghṛ̠tāhu̍tayo̠ yath sāmā̍ni̠ somā̍hutayo̠ yadatha̍rvāṅgi̠raso̠ maddhvā̍hutayo̠ yadbrā̎hma̠ṇānī̍tihā̠sānpu̍rā̠ṇāni̠ kalpā̠n gāthā̍ nārāśa̠g̠ͫsīrme̍dāhu̠tayo̍ de̠vānā̍mabhava̠ntābhiḥ̠ khṣudhaṃ̍ pā̠pmāna̠mapā̎ghna̠nnapa̍hatapāpmāno de̠vāḥ sva̠rgalm̐lo̠kamā̍ya̠n brahma̍ṇaḥ̠ sāyu̍jya̠mṛṣa̍yo'gacchann

pañca̠ vā e̠te ma̍hāya̠jñāḥ sa̍ta̠ti pratā̍yante sata̠ti santi̍ṣṭhante devaya̠jñaḥ pi̍tṛya̠jño bhū̍taya̠jño ma̍nuṣyaya̠jño bra̍hmaya̠jña iti̠ yada̠gnau ju̠hotya̠pi sa̠midhaṃ̠ tadde̍vaya̠jñaḥ santi̍ṣṭhate̠ yat pi̠tṛbhyaḥ̍ sva̠dhā ka̠rotyapya̠pastat pi̍tṛya̠jñaḥ santi̍ṣṭhate̠yadbhū̠tebhyo̍ ba̠ligͫ hara̍ti̠ tadbhū̍taya̠jñaḥ santi̍ṣṭhate̠ yadbrā̎hma̠ṇebhyo'nnaṃ̠ dadā̍ti̠ tanma̍nuṣyaya̠jñaḥ santi̍ṣṭhate̠ yathsvā̎ddhyā̠yamadhī̍yī̠taikā̍mapyṛ̠caym̐yajuḥ̠sāma̍ vā̠ tadbra̍hmaya̠jñaḥ santi̍ṣṭhate̠ yadṛ̠co'dhī̍te̠ paya̍saḥ̠ kūlyā̍ asya pi̠tṝn thsva̠dhā a̠bhiva̍hanti̠ yadyajū̍gͫṣi ghṛ̠tasya̍ kūlyā̠ yath sāmā̍ni̠ soma̍ ebhyaḥ pavate̠ yadatha̍rvāṅgi̠raso̠ madhoḥ̎ kūlyā̠ yadbrā̎hma̠ṇānī̍tihā̠sānpu̍rā̠ṇāni̠ kalpā̠n gāthā̍ nārāśa̠g̠ͫsīrmeda̍saḥ̠ kūlyā̍ asya pi̠tṝnth sva̠dhā a̠bhiva̍hanti̠ yadṛ̠co'dhī̍te̠ paya̍ āhutibhire̠va tadde̠vāgͫͫsta̍rpayati̠ yadyajū̍gͫṣi ghṛ̠tāhu̍tibhi̠ryath sāmā̍ni̠ somā̍hutibhi̠ryadatha̍rvāṅgi̠raso̠ maddhvā̍hutibhi̠ryadbrā̎hma̠ṇānī̍tihā̠sānpu̍rā̠ṇāni̠ kalpā̠n gāthā̍ nārāśa̠g̠ͫsīrme̍dāhu̠tibhi̍re̠va tadde̠vāgͫͫsta̍rpayati̠ ta e̍nan tṛ̠ptā āyu̍ṣā̠ teja̍sā̠ varca̍sā śri̠yā yaśa̍sā brahmavarca̠senā̠nnādye̍na ca tarpayanti

bra̠hma̠ya̠jñena̍ ya̠khṣyamā̍ṇaḥ̠ prācyāṃ̎ di̠śi grāmā̠dacha̍dirda̠r̠śa udī̎cyāṃ prāgudī̠cyāvm̐vo̠dita̍ ādi̠tye da̍khṣiṇa̠ta u̍pa̠vīyo̍pa̠viśya̠ hastā̍vava̠nijya̠ trirācā̍me̠ddviḥ pa̍ri̠mṛjya̍ sa̠kṛdu̍pa̠spṛśya̠ śira̠ścakhṣu̍ṣī̠ nāsi̍ke̠ śrotre̠ hṛda̍yamā̠labhya̠ yat trirā̠cāma̍ti̠ tena̠ ṛcaḥ̍ prīṇāti̠ yad dviḥ pa̍ri̠mṛja̍ti̠ tena̠ yajū̍gͫṣi̠ yath sa̠kṛdu̍pa̠spṛśa̍ti̠ tena̠ sāmā̍ni̠ (yath sa̠vyaṃ pā̠ṇiṃ pā̠dau pro̠khṣati̠) yacchira̠ścakhṣu̍ṣī̠ nāsi̍ke̠ śrotre̠ hṛda̍yamā̠labha̍te̠ tenātha̍rvāṅgi̠raso̎ brāhma̠ṇānī̍tihā̠sān pu̍rā̠ṇāni̠ kalpā̠n gāthā̍ nārāśa̠g̠ͫsīḥ prī̍ṇāti̠ darbhā̍ṇāṃ ma̠hadu̍pa̠stīryo̠pasthaṃ̍ kṛ̠tvā prāṅāsī̍naḥ svāddhyā̠yamadhī̍yītā̠pāvm̐vā e̠ṣa oṣa̍dhīnā̠g̠ͫ raso̠ yadda̠rbhāḥ sara̍same̠va brahma̍ kurute dakhṣiṇotta̠rau pā̠ṇī (pā̠dau) kṛ̠tvā sapa̠vitrā̠vomiti̠ prati̍padyata e̠tadvai yaju̍strayīvm̐vi̠dyāṃ pratye̠ṣā vāge̠tatpa̍ra̠mama̠khṣaraṃ̠ tade̠tadṛ̠cā'bhyu̍ktamṛ̠co a̠khṣare̍ para̠me vyo̍ma̠n̠yasmi̍n de̠vā adhi̠ viśve̍ niṣe̠duryastanna veda̠ kimṛ̠cā ka̍riṣyati̠ ya ittadvi̠dusta i̠me samā̍sata̠ iti̠ trīne̠va prāyu̍ṅkta̠ bhūrbhuvaḥ̠sva̍rityā̍hai̠tadvai vā̠caḥ sa̠tyaym̐yade̠va vā̠caḥ sa̠tyaṃ tat prāyu̠ṅktātha̍ sāvi̠trīṃ gā̍ya̠trīṃ triranvā̍ha pa̠ccho̎'drdharca̍śo'navā̠nagͫ sa̍vi̠tā śriyaḥ̍ prasavi̠tā śriya̍me̠vāpno̠t yatho̎ pra̠jñāta̍yai̠va pra̍ti̠padā̠ chandā̍gͫsi̠ prati̍padyate

grāme̠ mana̍sā svāddhyā̠yamadhī̍yīta̠ divā̠ nakta̍vm̐ve̠ti ha̍ smā̠ha śau̠ca ā̎hne̠ya u̠tāra̍ṇye̠'bala̍ u̠ta vā̠cota tiṣṭha̍nnu̠ta vraja̍nnu̠tāsī̍na u̠ta śayā̍no̠'dhīyī̍tai̠va svā̎ddhyā̠yaṃ tapa̍svī̠ puṇyo̍ bhavati̠ ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvānth svā̎ddhyā̠yamadhī̍te̠ namo̠ brahma̍ṇe̠ namo̍ astva̠gnaye̠ namaḥ̍ pṛthi̠vyai nama̠ oṣa̍dhībhyaḥ|
namo̍ vā̠ce namo̍ vā̠caspata̍ye̠ namo̠ viṣṇa̍ve bṛha̠te ka̍romi
ma̠ddhyandi̍ne pra̠bala̠madhī̍yītā̠sau khalu̠ vāvaiṣa ā̍di̠tyo yadbrā̎hma̠ṇastasmā̠ttarhi̠ tekhṣṇi̍ṣṭhaṃ tapati̠ tade̠ṣā'bhyu̍ktā||
ci̠traṃ de̠vānā̠muda̍gā̠danī̍kaṃ̠ cakhṣu̍rmi̠trasya̠ varu̍ṇasyā̠gneḥ|

ā'prā̠ dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī a̠ntari̍khṣa̠g̠ͫ sūrya̍ ā̠tmā jaga̍tasta̠sthuṣa̠śceti̠ sa vā e̠ṣa ya̠jñaḥ sa̠dyaḥ pratā̍yate sa̠dyaḥ santi̍ṣṭhate̠ tasya̠ prākhsā̠yama̍vabhṛ̠tho namo̠ brahma̍ṇa̠ iti̍ paridhā̠nīyāṃ̠ triranvā̍hā̠pa u̍pa̠spṛśya̍ gṛ̠hāne̍ti̠ tato̠ yatkiṃca̠ dadā̍ti̠ sā dakhṣi̍ṇā

tasya̠ vā e̠tasya̍ ya̠jñasya̠ megho̍ havi̠drdhāna̍vm̐vi̠dyuda̠gnirva̠r̠ṣagͫ ha̠viḥ sta̍nayi̠tnurva̍ṣaṭkā̠ro yada̍va̠sphūrja̍ti̠ so'nu̍vaṣaṭkā̠ro vā̠yurā̠tmā'mā̍vā̠syā̎ sviṣṭa̠kṛdya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvānme̠ghe va̠r̠ṣati̍ vi̠dyota̍māne sta̠naya̍tyava̠sphūrja̍ti̠ pava̍māne vā̠yāva̍māvā̠syā̍yāgͫͫ svāddhyā̠yamadhī̍te̠ tapa̍ e̠va tatta̍pyate̠ tapo̍ hi svāddhyā̠ya ityu̍tta̠maṃ nāka̍gͫ rohatyutta̠maḥ sa̍mā̠nānāṃ̎ bhavati̠ yāva̍ntagͫ ha̠ vā i̠māvm̐vi̠ttasya̍ pū̠rṇāṃ dada̍thsva̠rgalm̐lo̠kaṃ ja̍yati̠ tāva̍ntalm̐lo̠kaṃ ja̍yati̠ bhūyā̍gͫsaṃ cākhṣa̠yyaṃ cāpa̍ punarmṛ̠tyuṃ ja̍yati̠ brahma̍ṇaḥ̠ sāyu̍jyaṃ gacchati

tasya̠ vā e̠tasya̍ ya̠jñasya̠ dvāva̍naddhyā̠yau yadā̠''tmā'śuci̠ryadde̠śaḥ samṛ̍ddhirdaiva̠tāni̠ ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvān ma̍hārā̠tra u̠ṣasyudi̍te̠ vraja̠g̠ͫͫstiṣṭha̠nnāsī̍naḥ̠ śayā̍no̠'raṇye̎ grāme̠ vā yāva̍tta̠rasa̍gͫͫ svāddhyā̠yamadhī̍te̠ sarvā̎lm̐lo̠kāñja̍yati̠ sarvā̎lm̐lo̠kāna̍nṛ̠ṇo'nu̠ saṃca̍rati̠ tade̠ṣā'bhyu̍ktā||
a̠nṛ̠ṇā a̠sminna̍nṛ̠ṇāḥ para̍smigͫͫstṛ̠tīye̍ lo̠ke a̍nṛ̠ṇāḥ syā̍ma|

ye de̍va̠yānā̍ u̠ta pi̍tṛ̠yāṇāḥ̠ sarvā̎n pa̠tho a̍nṛ̠ṇā ākhṣī̍ye̠metya̠gnivm̐vai jā̠taṃ pā̠pmā ja̍grāha̠ taṃde̠vā āhu̍tībhiḥ pā̠pmāna̠mapā̎ghna̠nnāhu̍tīnāym̐ya̠jñena̍ ya̠jñasya̠ dakhṣi̍ṇābhi̠rdakhṣi̍ṇānāṃ brāhma̠ṇena̍ brāhma̠ṇasya̠ chando̍bhiḥ̠ chanda̍sāgͫͫ svāddhyā̠yenāpa̍hatapāpmā svāddhyā̠yo̍ de̠vapa̍vitra̠vm̐vā e̠tattaym̐yo'nū̎th sṛ̠jatyabhā̍go vā̠ci bha̍va̠tyabhā̍go nā̠ke tade̠ṣā'bhyu̍ktā||
yasti̠tyāja̍ sakhi̠vida̠g̠ͫ sakhā̍yaṃ̠ na tasya̍ vā̠cyapi̍ bhā̠go a̍sti|

yadī̍gͫ śṛ̠ṇotya̠laka̍gͫ śṛṇoti̠ na hi pra̠veda̍ sukṛ̠tasya̠ panthā̠miti̠ tasmā̎th svāddhyā̠yo'ddhye̍ta̠vyo̍ yaym̐yaṃ̍ kra̠tumadhī̍te̠ tena̍ tenāsye̠ṣṭaṃ bha̍vatya̠gnervā̠yorā̍di̠tyasya̠ sāyu̍jyaṃ gacchati̠ tade̠ṣā'bhyu̍ktā||

ye a̠rvāṅu̠ta vā̍ purā̠ṇe ve̠davm̐vi̠dvāgͫsa̍ma̠bhito̍ vadantyādi̠tyame̠va te pari̍vadanti̠ sarve̍ a̠gniṃ dvi̠tīyaṃ̍ tṛ̠tīyaṃ̍ ca ha̠g̠ͫsamiti̠ yāva̍tī̠rvai de̠vatā̠stāḥ sarvā̍ veda̠vidi̍ brāhma̠ṇe va̍santi̠ tasmā̎d brāhma̠ṇebhyo̍ veda̠vidbhyo̍ di̠vedi̍ve̠ nama̍skuryā̠nnāślī̠laṃ kī̎rtayede̠tā e̠va de̠vatāḥ̎ prīṇāti

ricya̍ta iva̠ vā e̠ṣa preva ri̍cyate̠ yo yā̠jaya̍ti̠ prati̍ vā gṛ̠hṇāti̍ yā̠jayi̍tvā pratigṛ̠hya vā'na̍śna̠ntriḥ svā̎ddhyā̠yavm̐ve̠damadhī̍yīta trirā̠travm̐vā̍ sāvi̠trīṃ gā̍ya̠trīma̠nvāti̍recayati̠ varo̠ dakhṣi̍ṇā̠ vare̍ṇai̠va vara̍gͫͫ spṛṇotyā̠tmā hi varaḥ̍

du̠he ha̠ vā e̠ṣa chandā̍gͫsi̠ yo yā̠jaya̍ti̠ sa yena̍ yajñakra̠tunā̍ yā̠jaye̠th so'ra̍ṇyaṃ pa̠retya̍ śucau de̠śe svā̎ddhyā̠yame̠vaina̠madhī̍yannāsī̠ta tasyā̠naśa̍naṃ dī̠khṣā sthā̠namu̍pa̠sada̠ āsa̍nagͫ su̠tyā vāgju̠hūrmana̍ upa̠bhṛddhṛ̠tidrdhru̠vā prā̠ṇo ha̠viḥ sāmā̎ddhva̠ryuḥ sa vā e̠ṣa ya̠jñaḥ prā̠ṇada̍khṣi̠ṇo'na̍ntadakhṣiṇaḥ̠ samṛ̍ddhataraḥ

ka̠ti̠dhā'va̍kīrṇī pravi̠śati̍ catu̠drdhetyā̍hurbrahmavā̠dino̍ ma̠rutaḥ̍ prā̠ṇairindraṃ̠ bale̍na̠ bṛha̠spatiṃ̍ brahmavarca̠senā̠gnime̠veta̍reṇa̠ sarve̍ṇa̠ tasyai̠tāṃ prāya̍ścittivm̐vi̠dāñca̍kāra sude̠vaḥ kā̎śya̠po yo bra̍hmacā̠rya̍va̠kire̍damāvā̠syā̍yā̠g̠ͫ rātryā̍ma̠gniṃ pra̠ṇīyo̍pasamā̠dhāya̠ dvirājya̍syopa̠ghātaṃ̍ juhoti̠ kāmāva̍kīrṇo̠'smyava̍kīrṇo'smi̠ kāma̠ kāmā̍ya̠ svāhā̠ kāmābhi̍drugdho̠'smyabhi̍drugdho'smi̠ kāma̠ kāmā̍ya̠ svāhetya̠mṛta̠vm̐vā ājya̍ma̠mṛta̍me̠vātman dha̍tte hu̠tvā praya̍tāñja̠liḥ kavā̍tiryaṅṅa̠gnima̠bhi ma̍ntrayeta̠ saṃ mā̍ siñcantu ma̠rutaḥ̠ samindraḥ̠ saṃbṛha̠spatiḥ̍|

saṃ mā̠'yama̠gniḥ si̍ñca̠tvāyu̍ṣā ca̠ bale̍na̠ cāyu̍ṣmantaṃ karota̠ meti̠ prati̍ hāsmai ma̠rutaḥ̍ prā̠ṇān da̍dhati̠ pratīndro̠ balaṃ̠ prati̠ bṛha̠spati̍r brahmavarca̠saṃ pratya̠gniri̠tara̠thsarva̠g̠ͫ sarva̍tanurbhū̠tvā sarva̠māyu̍reti̠ trira̠bhima̍ntrayeta̠ triṣa̍tyā̠ hi de̠vā yo'pū̍ta iva̠ manye̍ta̠ sa i̠tthaṃ ju̍huyādi̠ttha ma̠bhima̍ntrayeta̠ punī̍ta e̠vātmāna̠māyu̍re̠vātman dha̍tte̠ varo̠ dakhṣi̍ṇā̠ vare̍ṇai̠va vara̍gͫͫ spṛṇotyā̠tmā hi varaḥ̍
